levels.101.title: The Letter on the Rainy Night
levels.101.teachingGoal: Learn the basic rule of Sudoku: no repeated numbers in any row or column. Try to fill in the first number.
levels.101.triggers.t100_f1.text: Shen Mo confirms the first number. Both the row and the column are now clear.
levels.101.triggers.t100_f2.text: He keeps filling. With each number, one more gap in the rows and columns closes.
levels.101.triggers.t100_st.text: Shen Mo pauses and scans the row and column again... he missed a number that was already there.
levels.102.title: Trail of the Old Bookshop
levels.102.teachingGoal: Learn about boxes: each 2×2 box also contains 1-4 without repetition. Use all three rules—rows, columns, and boxes—together!
levels.102.triggers.t101_s.text: Welcome! Gray numbers are givens. Look at the small numbers (notes) beside each empty cell—if only one candidate remains, that's a Lone Star; fill it in directly!
levels.102.triggers.t101_f.text: Correct! 🎉 In every row, column, and 2×2 box, 1-4 each appear exactly once!
levels.102.triggers.t101_c.text: A number is repeated! Check the row, column, and box~
levels.103.title: Shadows in the Alley
levels.103.teachingGoal: Learn about cages: the dashed outline is a cage, and the number in its top-left corner is the cage's sum. For a single-cell cage, fill in the number equal to its sum!
levels.103.triggers.t102_s.text: Look at the dashed outline! This is a cage, and the top-left number is its total sum. For a 1-cell cage, fill in whatever the sum is!
levels.103.triggers.t102_f.text: Right! A single-cell cage is a freebie 🎉
levels.104.title: The Visitor Su Wan
levels.104.teachingGoal: Learn about notes: the small numbers in a cell are candidates. If only one candidate remains in the notes, that's the answer!
levels.104.triggers.t103_h.text: Focused training! Only these empty cells remain—they're all Lone Stars. Fill them in by reading the notes!
levels.105.title: The Library's Outer Wall
levels.105.teachingGoal: A 2-cell cage with sum 3/4/6/7 has a unique combination! Mnemonic: 3=1+2, 4=1+3, 6=2+4, 7=3+4
levels.105.triggers.t104_s.text: A 2-cell cage with sum 3/4/6/7 has unique digits! Mnemonic: 3 needs 1+2, 4 needs 1+3, 6 needs 2+4, 7 needs 3+4!
levels.105.triggers.t104_f.text: You found the unique combination! This is the first key to Killer Sudoku 🎉
levels.105.triggers.t104_st.text: 💡 Look at the cages! Sum 3=1+2, sum 4=1+3—combine with rows, columns, and boxes to pin down the positions!
levels.106.title: The Masonry Key
levels.106.teachingGoal: Learn Hidden Radiance: when Lone Stars aren't enough, scan the numbers! When a number can only go in one position in a row/column/box, that's the answer!
levels.106.triggers.t105_s.text: What to do when Lone Stars and unique combinations run out? Find the Hidden Radiance! Don't just count notes in a cell—scan the numbers. For example, where can the number 3 still go in the first row?
levels.106.triggers.t105_st.text: 💡 Scan the numbers! Where can 3 go in the first row? There's only one position in the whole row for 3!
levels.107.title: First Step into the Hidden Stairs
levels.107.teachingGoal: Reinforce unique combinations: become fluent with the unique combinations of 3/4/6/7
levels.107.triggers.t106_h.text: Combination training! Solve these cages using the unique-combination mnemonic~
levels.108.title: Relic in the Mezzanine
levels.108.teachingGoal: Learn the Rule of 10: in a 4×4 grid, every row/column/box sums to 10!
levels.108.triggers.t107_s.text: Here comes the big one! The Rule of 10: in a 4×4 grid, every row/column/box always sums to 10 (1+2+3+4=10)! Subtract the known numbers from 10 and you can work out the rest!
levels.108.triggers.t107_st.text: 💡 Look at the first row! 10-4-2=4, then check the cage sum of 4—you know the two numbers are 1 and 3!
levels.109.title: Prologue Finale · The First Closed Loop
levels.109.teachingGoal: Comprehensive practice: Lone Star, unique combinations, Hidden Radiance, and the Rule of 10
levels.109.triggers.t108_s.text: Chapter One comprehensive test! Use every technique—Lone Star, unique combinations, Hidden Radiance, and the Rule of 10!
levels.201.title: B1 Corridor
levels.201.triggers.t201_start.text: Welcome to the 6×6 grid! Numbers are 1-6. Look at this row—its numbers always add up to 21. Subtract the known numbers from 21: 21-4-1-2-3-6=5, so the empty cell is 5!
levels.201.triggers.t201_calc_intro.text: There's a '45' button in the top-right corner—it opens the brass abacus calculator~ Use it to work out combinations when you're unsure!
levels.201.triggers.t201_first_fill.text: Correct! The Star Balance Law is that simple: the row sums to 21, subtract the known numbers, and what's left is the answer~ The same applies to columns and boxes!
levels.201.triggers.t201_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've mastered the row Star Balance. Keep going—the remaining cells can be solved the same way!
levels.201.triggers.t201_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Remember: every row in a 6×6 grid sums to 21. Subtract all known numbers in the row from 21 to get the value of the empty cell!
levels.201.triggers.t201_st40.text: 💡 Look at this row again—add up all the numbers: subtract them from 21, and that single empty cell is the answer! Try clicking the '45' button in the top-right to use the calculator~
levels.201.triggers.t201_ag.text: ⚠️ That number isn't right! Check whether this row sums to 21? Use elimination and think again~
levels.201.triggers.t201_fit.text: ✨ Finishing phase! Just a few cells left—keep the rhythm, victory is in sight!
levels.201.triggers.t201_c.text: 🎉 Row Star Balance mastered! The rule that every row sums to 21 will be your first key to cracking the cage game.
levels.202.title: Fragment at the Fork
levels.202.triggers.t202_start.text: Columns work the same way! Every column also sums to 21. Look at this column: 21-4-6-2-3-5=1, so the empty cell is 1~
levels.202.triggers.t202_rowcol.text: Both rows and columns follow the Star Balance Law—use them flexibly from now on~ The brass abacus in the top-right is always there to help you calculate!
levels.202.triggers.t202_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've mastered the column Star Balance too. Cross-verify rows and columns—from here it's smooth sailing!
levels.202.triggers.t202_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Don't just look at rows! Check each column—find a column with only one empty cell, and 21 minus the other numbers is the answer!
levels.202.triggers.t202_st40.text: 💡 Remember the three pillars of the Star Balance Law: rows sum to 21, columns sum to 21, boxes sum to 21. Now try finding a column with the fewest empty cells?
levels.202.triggers.t202_ag.text: ⚠️ Don't guess! Check whether the column sums to 21? If not, try a different number~
levels.202.triggers.t202_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! A few cells left—verify with both rows and columns to avoid mistakes!
levels.202.triggers.t202_c.text: 🎉 Column Star Balance secured! Rows and columns are both your weapons now—ready for the box Star Balance?
levels.203.title: A Moment Under the Bridge
levels.203.teachingGoal: Star Balance Law for boxes + basic cages
levels.203.triggers.t203_start.text: Boxes are no exception! Each 2×3 box also sums to 21. Look at this box: 1+2+6+5=14, 21-14=7, so the remaining two cells add up to 7~
levels.203.triggers.t203_calc.text: Cages are back! Use the brass abacus (the '45' button in the top-right) to work out the possible number combinations in a cage~
levels.203.triggers.t203_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! Dual reasoning with box Star Balance + cage cells is underway—you've truly entered the realm of Killer Sudoku!
levels.203.triggers.t203_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? First check each 2×3 box—box sums to 21, subtract and you'll find single-cell answers! Then check the cage sums—two approaches at once!
levels.203.triggers.t203_st40.text: 💡 Cage sums are key! For example, a 2-cell cage summing to 3 must be 1+2, and one summing to 4 must be 1+3—then combine with the box Star Balance Law to eliminate!
levels.203.triggers.t203_ag.text: ⚠️ Check! Is the cage sum right? Any repeats in the box? Star Balance numbers never lie~
levels.203.triggers.t203_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! Verify with cages, rows, columns, and boxes—steady through the final steps!
levels.203.triggers.t203_c.text: 🎉 Box Star Balance and basic cages mastered! You've learned the three great sum weapons of Killer Sudoku!
levels.204.title: The Old Residence No. 72
levels.204.teachingGoal: 9×9 grid + introduction to the Star Balance Law
levels.204.triggers.t204_start.text: 📜 Master's Notes: 'Welcome to the Nine-Realm Star Chart. From today, you face a true standard 9×9 grid. From 1 to 9, every row sums to 45.'
levels.204.triggers.t204_story2.text: 📜 'The Star Balance Law—the core of my lifelong calculations. Remember it; it will be your sharpest reasoning weapon.'
levels.204.triggers.t204_45.text: 📜 'Good, a steady first step. You may use the brass abacus freely—it won't think for you, but it will help you calculate.'
levels.204.triggers.t204_bt.text: ⚡ 📜 'Breakthrough. You've grasped the essence of the Star Balance Law—from now on, the Nine-Realm Star Chart holds no mystery for you.'
levels.204.triggers.t204_st20.text: 💡 📜 '45 is the Star Balance base of the nine realms. Find the row, column, or 3×3 box with the fewest empty cells; subtract the known numbers from 45 and the answer reveals itself.'
levels.204.triggers.t204_st40.text: 💡 📜 'Do not rush. The Nine-Realm Star Chart rewards a panoramic view—scan all rows/columns/boxes first; finding the breakthrough matters more than blind filling.'
levels.204.triggers.t204_ag.text: ⚠️ 📜 'A miss by a hair is a miss by a mile. Check whether the row/column/box sums to 45, then reconsider.'
levels.204.triggers.t204_fit.text: ✨ 📜 'Finishing. The Nine-Realm Star Chart is nearly complete—feel the power of the Star Balance Law.'
levels.204.triggers.t204_c.text: 🎉 📜 'The Nine-Realm Star Chart is solved. You are now a true heir of the Star Balance Law—keep going; greater puzzles await.'
levels.205.title: Deciphering the Old Manuscript
levels.205.teachingGoal: Deduce a single cell using the Star Balance Law
levels.205.triggers.t205_start.text: 📜 Master's Notes: 'Cages are back. Look closely—some cages reach into a row, some extend beyond it. With the Star Balance Law, you can work out that "extra" cell.'
levels.205.triggers.t205_first.text: 📜 'Beautiful. This is the single-cell difference method—subtract the known from the whole to get the unknown. Simple, yet the most fundamental weapon.'
levels.205.triggers.t205_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! Difference reasoning is underway—the numbers hidden in the cages reveal themselves one by one!
levels.205.triggers.t205_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Find cages that cross a box! If only one cell of a cage lies outside a box, the cage sum minus 45 gives that cell's value!
levels.205.triggers.t205_st40.text: 💡 Difference method mnemonic: cage crosses a box, count the cells, the difference is that cell. For example, if a cage has 8 cells in a box and sums to 40, the protruding cell is 5!
levels.205.triggers.t205_ag.text: ⚠️ Take it easy! If the difference is wrong, everything goes wrong—recalculate the difference between the cage sum and 45!
levels.205.triggers.t205_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! All single-cell differences are worked out—what remains is basic elimination!
levels.205.triggers.t205_c.text: 🎉 Single-cell difference mastered! This is the sharpest dagger of the Star Balance Law, striking straight at the heart of the puzzle!
levels.206.title: Return to the Underground
levels.206.triggers.t206_start.text: This time the cages are bigger! Sometimes the difference spans more than one cell—you need to work out the sum of several cells, then deduce the numbers within~
levels.206.triggers.t206_combo.text: The cage combination calculator is unlocked! Click the 'Combination' button on the toolbar to see the possible number combinations for an n-cell cage~
levels.206.triggers.t206_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! Multi-cell difference + combination calculator—double firepower unleashed!
levels.206.triggers.t206_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Find cages that cross a box, subtract from 45 to get the sum of the protruding part, then use the combination calculator to see which number combinations make that sum!
levels.206.triggers.t206_st40.text: 💡 How to use the combination calculator: click the '45' button → enter the number of cells and the sum → it lists all possible combinations, then filter with elimination!
levels.206.triggers.t206_ag.text: ⚠️ Verify before filling—is this number in the combination? Any repeats in the row/column/box?
levels.206.triggers.t206_fit.text: ✨ Finishing phase! The combination range keeps shrinking—the last few cells are almost within reach!
levels.206.triggers.t206_c.text: 🎉 Multi-cell difference and the combination calculator, two blades as one! You've gained another divine tool!
levels.207.title: Entrance to the B2 Stone Chamber
levels.207.triggers.t207_start.text: Observe the relationship between cages and rows/columns/boxes—some cages lie entirely inside, some extend outward. The Star Balance Law can help you work out those 'extra cells'~
levels.207.triggers.t207_first.text: Nice! This is the essence of inside/outside cages—subtract the known part from the whole 45, and what remains is that 'protruding cell'. Keep it up~
levels.207.triggers.t207_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! The secret of inside/outside cages is revealed—innies and outies can no longer hide!
levels.207.triggers.t207_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Review the cages in each 3×3 box—cages fully inside a box should sum to 45 or less; if more than 45, the difference is the protruding cell!
levels.207.triggers.t207_st40.text: 💡 Innie technique: the sum of all cages in a box minus 45 = the sum of all outie cells. If there's only one outie cell, you get the answer directly!
levels.207.triggers.t207_ag.text: ⚠️ Careful! If you misjudge which cage a cell belongs to, the whole board goes wrong—check the dashed boundaries again!
levels.207.triggers.t207_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! Inside and outside cages all unlocked—the final answer comes naturally!
levels.207.triggers.t207_c.text: 🎉 The inside/outside cage method is complete! You've mastered all the basic applications of the Star Balance Law!
levels.208.title: The Empty B2 Room
levels.208.extract.message: Message decoded %s—the first frequency left by the teacher. Write it down.
levels.208.triggers.t208_start.text: 📜 Master's Notes: 'The Star Balance Trial—the second test I left behind. Use everything you've learned to solve it.'
levels.208.triggers.t208_story2.text: 📜 'Pass this puzzle and you'll earn the Brass Abacus Badge—proof of a Star Balance apprentice.'
levels.208.triggers.t208_f1.text: 📜 'A good start. Remember—the Star Balance Trial has no shortcuts; only by using everything you've learned.'
levels.208.triggers.t208_bt.text: ⚡ 📜 'Breakthrough! You've found the key opening—press the advantage and give the puzzle no chance to breathe!'
levels.208.triggers.t208_st20.text: 💡 📜 'Impatience is the enemy of reasoning. Re-examine the board: rows, columns, boxes, cages, differences—which clue did you miss?'
levels.208.triggers.t208_st40.text: 💡 📜 'Step back and the view widens. Try starting from a different box/cage—sometimes the answer appears from another angle. Make good use of the combination calculator.'
levels.208.triggers.t208_ag.text: ⚠️ 📜 'Wrong. The Star Balance never lies—trace back your reasoning chain. Where did it break?'
levels.208.triggers.t208_fit.text: ✨ 📜 'Finishing! The answer is right before you—the Star Balance Apprentice Badge is about to be yours!'
levels.208.triggers.t208_c.text: 🎉 Congratulations on passing the Star Balance Trial! The Brass Abacus Badge—'Star Balance Apprentice'—is unlocked! You are now qualified to enter the Library's underground.
levels.209.title: Traces in the Stone Chamber
levels.209.teachingGoal: End-of-chapter exam: the 45 Star Balance compendium
levels.301.title: The Hidden Door
levels.301.teachingGoal: Block Severance (row block): when a number can only appear in the same row within a box, that number can be eliminated from other cells in that row.
levels.301.triggers.t301_multirow.text: Try adding two rows together? 21×2=42—sometimes that reveals a breakthrough!
levels.301.triggers.t301_f1.text: Right! This is Block Severance—when a number can only appear in this row within the box, eliminate it from all other cells in the row!
levels.301.triggers.t301_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You found the key row-block severance—the chain reaction begins!
levels.301.triggers.t301_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Pick a number and check its possible positions in a 3×3 box—if they all fall in the same row, eliminate it from the rest of that row!
levels.301.triggers.t301_st40.text: 💡 Row block mnemonic: 'Box sees row, row deletes the rest.' Open the notes (✏️), mark all candidates, and the block will reveal itself!
levels.301.triggers.t301_ag.text: ⚠️ Guessing won't work! Find the block evidence before filling—if the notes aren't marked, mark them first!
levels.301.triggers.t301_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The ripple of Block Severance cleared the last obstacles—keep sprinting!
levels.301.triggers.t301_c.text: 🎉 Row block severance mastered! This is the cornerstone of all advanced techniques.
levels.302.title: B1 Corridor
levels.302.teachingGoal: Block Severance (column block): when a number can only appear in the same column within a box, that number can be eliminated from other cells in that column.
levels.302.triggers.t302_s.text: Level 2: column block! Last level you learned row-direction Block Severance; this level it's column-direction—same principle, different direction!
levels.302.triggers.t302_f1.text: Nice! Column blocks and row blocks are twins—look at the column within the box, delete the rest of the column!
levels.302.triggers.t302_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! Column block severance kicks in—the numbers on the board start filling in a chain reaction!
levels.302.triggers.t302_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Look vertically! Pick a number and see which column it can only appear in within a box—then eliminate it from the rest of that column!
levels.302.triggers.t302_st40.text: 💡 Don't forget the Star Balance Law still works! Sometimes locking down a number with Star Balance makes the block appear naturally.
levels.302.triggers.t302_ag.text: ⚠️ Don't rush to fill! Are you sure this number can't go anywhere else in the column? Check once more~
levels.302.triggers.t302_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! Both row and column blocks in play—the last few cells fall easily!
levels.302.triggers.t302_c.text: 🎉 Column block secured! You've mastered severance in both row and column directions!
levels.303.title: The B2 Secret Chamber
levels.303.teachingGoal: Block Severance (box block): when a number can only appear in the same 3×3 box within a row/column, that number can be eliminated from other cells in that box.
levels.303.triggers.t303_s.text: Level 3: box block! The direction is reversed—if a number can only appear in the same box across an entire row, eliminate it from the other cells in that box!
levels.303.triggers.t303_f1.text: Great! Box block is reverse reasoning: look at the box from the row/column, not the row/column from the box!
levels.303.triggers.t303_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've spotted the box block—a whole swath of notes gets eliminated!
levels.303.triggers.t303_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Scan in the other direction: check all positions a number can occupy in a row—if they're all in the same 3×3 box, eliminate it from the other cells in that box!
levels.303.triggers.t303_st40.text: 💡 Box block mnemonic: 'Row sees box, box deletes the rest.' Note marking is your best friend—remember to turn on the ✏️ button!
levels.303.triggers.t303_ag.text: ⚠️ Look more carefully—are this number's positions in the row really all in the same box?
levels.303.triggers.t303_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! You can now use all three block directions—row, column, and box—flexibly. The last steps are solid!
levels.303.triggers.t303_c.text: 🎉 Box block mastered! All three directions of Block Severance are cleared!
levels.304.title: Seven Puzzles · One
levels.304.teachingGoal: 9×9 grid Star Balance review and consolidation: comprehensive use of row, column, and box Star Balance Laws plus difference techniques.
levels.304.triggers.t304_welcome_9x9.tex: Welcome to the 9×9 world! The numbers are now 1-9, but all techniques still apply~
levels.304.triggers.t304_f1.text: Not bad! Solid fundamentals—keep it up!
levels.304.triggers.t304_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! The key clue is found—the board starts to loosen!
levels.304.triggers.t304_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Don't forget the weapons you've learned: Star Balance (row/column/box), difference, Block Severance—one of them will always work!
levels.304.triggers.t304_st40.text: 💡 Change your approach: scan all cages and differences first, then look for blocks—don't fixate on one spot!
levels.304.triggers.t304_ag.text: ⚠️ Don't guess! Return to the techniques you've learned and find a definite reasoning chain!
levels.304.triggers.t304_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The review level is nearly done—you're ready for new techniques!
levels.304.triggers.t304_c.text: 🎉 Nine-Realm review complete! The foundation is solid—ready to learn about pairs?
levels.305.title: Seven Puzzles · Two
levels.305.teachingGoal: Twin Lock (Naked Pair) introduction: when two cells in the same row/column/box can only hold the same two numbers, those two numbers can be eliminated from other cells in that region.
levels.305.triggers.t305_s.text: New technique: Twin Lock! If two empty cells in a row can only hold the same two numbers (say 3 and 7), those two cells occupy 3 and 7, so the other cells in the row can eliminate 3 and 7!
levels.305.triggers.t305_f1.text: Sharp eyes! You found the first pair! This is a 'Naked Pair'—two cells that can only possibly be two numbers!
levels.305.triggers.t305_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! The pair eliminated a large swath of notes—the board opens right up!
levels.305.triggers.t305_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Open the notes (✏️), mark all possible numbers in each empty cell, then find pairs of cells with exactly the same two notes!
levels.305.triggers.t305_st40.text: 💡 Pairs don't have to be in the same row—same column or box works too! As long as two cells in the same region (row/column/box) share exactly the same two notes, it's a pair!
levels.305.triggers.t305_ag.text: ⚠️ Be careful judging pairs—both cells must have exactly these two notes and nothing more, or it doesn't count!
levels.305.triggers.t305_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The power of pairs brings the final numbers into view one by one!
levels.305.triggers.t305_c.text: 🎉 Twin Lock mastered! This is the first domino of advanced reasoning!
levels.306.title: Seven Puzzles · Three
levels.306.teachingGoal: Combined use: Block Severance and Twin Lock together, plus the Star Balance Law—multiple techniques working as one.
levels.306.triggers.t306_s.text: Combination level! This level requires Block Severance and pairs at the same time—the techniques trigger each other in a chain reaction!
levels.306.triggers.t306_f1.text: Nice! The first breakthrough is found—the chain reaction will get smoother from here!
levels.306.triggers.t306_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! The one-two punch of pairs + blocks is working—the board starts to crumble!
levels.306.triggers.t306_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? First find pairs to lock candidates, then use Block Severance to delete more—alternate between the two techniques!
levels.306.triggers.t306_st40.text: 💡 Don't forget the Star Balance Law and cage combinations! Basic techniques never go out of style—they're often the start of the chain!
levels.306.triggers.t306_ag.text: ⚠️ One wrong step leads to many! Before filling each number, confirm it passes all constraints!
levels.306.triggers.t306_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! Multiple techniques working in concert—the last few cells are in the bag!
levels.306.triggers.t306_c.text: 🎉 Combination use perfected! You can now switch flexibly between multiple reasoning techniques!
levels.307.title: B3 Entrance
levels.307.teachingGoal: Chapter Three comprehensive test: Star Balance Law, Block Severance (row/column/box), and Twin Lock—use all advanced foundational techniques together.
levels.307.triggers.t307_s.text: 📜 The Library's underground trial! Use Star Balance, Block Severance, and Twin Lock together to prove you're worthy of going deeper!
levels.307.triggers.t307_f1.text: A good start! The teacher's puzzles are cunning, but you now have the weapons to crack them!
levels.307.triggers.t307_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've torn through the first line of the teacher's puzzle—press the advantage!
levels.307.triggers.t307_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Take a deep breath and scan from the start: fill Lone Stars → find differences with Star Balance → find pairs → find blocks, step by step!
levels.307.triggers.t307_st40.text: 💡 The teacher likes to hide clues in plain sight—did you miss a simple Star Balance Law? Is any cage sum unusual?
levels.307.triggers.t307_ag.text: ⚠️ The teacher's trap! This number looks reasonable but violates some constraint—check more carefully!
levels.307.triggers.t307_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The badge is within reach—don't slip on the final step!
levels.307.triggers.t307_c.text: 🎉 Congratulations on passing the deep trial! The Intermediate Detective Badge is unlocked! A dust-covered cold case deeper in the Library awaits you!
levels.308.title: The Transmitter
levels.309.title: The Door at the Deepest Point
levels.401.title: 94 Dongyuhang Road
levels.401.teachingGoal: Systematic notes: learn to systematically mark notes with the ✏️ button—this is the foundation of all advanced techniques.
levels.401.triggers.t401_45intro.text: Every row in a 9×9 grid sums to 45! Subtract 45 from the cage sum, and the excess is the number that 'sticks out'~
levels.401.triggers.t401_s.text: Welcome to the dust-covered cold case! Level 1: notes. The foundation of advanced techniques is note marking—click the ✏️ button and start marking each empty cell's possible numbers!
levels.401.triggers.t401_f1.text: Good! Note marking helps you see patterns the naked eye easily misses—keep marking!
levels.401.triggers.t401_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! Once the notes are in place, the hidden patterns begin to emerge!
levels.401.triggers.t401_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Open the notes (✏️) and mark every empty cell's possible numbers—advanced techniques all rely on notes!
levels.401.triggers.t401_st40.text: 💡 Marking tips: scan each number 1-9, use elimination to mark possible numbers in each cell, then look for patterns! Click the '45' in the top-right to open the calculator for help!
levels.401.triggers.t401_ag.text: ⚠️ Don't fill by feel! Look at the notes—if there are multiple candidates, you need further reasoning, not guessing!
levels.401.triggers.t401_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The notes helped you lock in the final answer!
levels.401.triggers.t401_c.text: 🎉 Notes have become second nature! Advanced techniques are no longer out of reach!
levels.402.title: Room 402
levels.402.teachingGoal: Hidden Single advanced: in a row/column/box, a number has only one position to fill, even if that cell has other notes.
levels.402.triggers.t402_s.text: Level 2: Hidden Single! Sometimes a cell has several notes, but a certain number can only go in this one position across the whole row/column/box—that's a Hidden Single!
levels.402.triggers.t402_f1.text: Found it! This is a Hidden Single—though the cell has multiple notes, the number 5 can only go here in this row!
levels.402.triggers.t402_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've found the key Hidden Radiance—the chain of eliminations begins!
levels.402.triggers.t402_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Don't just look at cells with few notes! Scan number by number (1 to 9) and check how many possible positions each number has in every row/column/box!
levels.402.triggers.t402_st40.text: 💡 Hidden Singles often hide in cells with many notes! Lone Star looks at cells, Hidden Radiance looks at numbers—scan from a different angle!
levels.402.triggers.t402_ag.text: ⚠️ Are you sure this number really has only this one position in the whole row/column/box? Scan again!
levels.402.triggers.t402_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! Alternating Hidden Radiance and Lone Star—the last few cells hold no suspense!
levels.402.triggers.t402_c.text: 🎉 Hidden Single mastered! 'Lone Star looks at cells, Hidden Radiance looks at numbers'—remember this eight-character mantra!
levels.403.title: Room 403
levels.403.teachingGoal: Pair placement: Twin Luminary (Hidden Pair)—two numbers can only appear in the same two cells within a region, so those two cells eliminate other candidates.
levels.403.triggers.t403_s.text: Level 3: pair placement (Twin Luminary)! Last chapter you learned Twin Lock; this level you learn its opposite—two numbers can only go in two cells, even if those cells have other candidates!
levels.403.triggers.t403_f1.text: Clever! You've spotted the Twin Luminary—though these two cells have multiple candidates, the numbers 2 and 6 can only be among them, so all other candidates are deleted!
levels.403.triggers.t403_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! The Twin Luminary surfaces, deleting a large number of redundant candidates!
levels.403.triggers.t403_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Pick two numbers and check their possible positions in a row/column/box—if they fall on exactly the same two cells, that's a Twin Luminary!
levels.403.triggers.t403_st40.text: 💡 Twin Luminaries are harder to spot than Twin Locks—scan pairs of numbers one by one! 1 and 4, 2 and 7, 3 and 8... search patiently!
levels.403.triggers.t403_ag.text: ⚠️ Are you certain these two numbers really only go in these two cells? Don't miss a third possible position!
levels.403.triggers.t403_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! Naked + Twin Luminary, two blades as one—the final answer is crystal clear!
levels.403.triggers.t403_c.text: 🎉 Twin Luminary mastered! Both forms of the pair are now conquered!
levels.404.title: Room 404
levels.404.teachingGoal: Three Seed Method (Naked Triple): three cells in the same region contain exactly 3 different numbers, so those 3 numbers can be eliminated from other cells in the region.
levels.404.triggers.t404_calc_tool.text: The '45' button on the toolbar is the combination calculator—use it when you're unsure about combinations!
levels.404.triggers.t404_s.text: Level 4: Naked Triple! First advance the board with basic elimination—the three-cell, three-number structure of the Three Seed Method will soon appear. From pairs to triples, the scale grows and the power increases!
levels.404.triggers.t404_f1.text: A good start! Now observe: find three cells in the same row/column/box whose notes together are exactly three different numbers (say 2, 5, 8)—that's the Three Seed Method!
levels.404.triggers.t404_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've locked onto the Three Seed Method—a row of notes is swept clean!
levels.404.triggers.t404_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Find three cells whose notes together are exactly three different numbers (say 2, 5, 8)—that's the Three Seed Method!
levels.404.triggers.t404_st40.text: 💡 The Three Seed Method doesn't require every cell to have three notes! For example, {2,5}{5,8}{2,8} is also a Three Seed Method—together they're exactly three numbers. Make good use of the calculator tool!
levels.404.triggers.t404_ag.text: ⚠️ Judging the Three Seed Method: the three cells' notes together must be exactly three numbers—one more doesn't count!
levels.404.triggers.t404_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! From pairs to the Three Seed Method, your reasoning arsenal grows richer!
levels.404.triggers.t404_c.text: 🎉 Three Seed Method mastered! The leap from pairs to triples has greatly boosted your reasoning power!
levels.404.triggers.t404_pre.text: 🔍 The Three Seed Method is right before you! Observe the notes: is there a set of three cells whose candidates together are exactly three numbers? They'll lock that region and eliminate those candidates from other cells!
levels.405.title: Pan Hanyu's Note
levels.405.teachingGoal: In-cage elimination: use cage sum constraints and combination limits to eliminate impossible notes from cells within a cage.
levels.405.triggers.t405_s.text: Level 5: in-cage elimination! A technique unique to Killer Sudoku—use the cage's sum and combination limits to directly eliminate notes from cells inside the cage!
levels.405.triggers.t405_f1.text: Nice! Cage combinations are powerful elimination tools by themselves—a 2-cell cage summing to 17 can only be 8+9!
levels.405.triggers.t405_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've found the unique combination of a key cage—a whole batch of numbers is confirmed!
levels.405.triggers.t405_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Look at big cages! Cages with large sums and many cells often have unique combinations. For example, a 4-cell cage summing to 10 can only be 1+2+3+4!
levels.405.triggers.t405_st40.text: 💡 Use the combination calculator (the '45' button)! Enter the number of cells and the sum, and it lists all possible combinations to help you eliminate quickly!
levels.405.triggers.t405_ag.text: ⚠️ Confirm before filling: is this number in the cage's possible combinations? Any repeats in the cage? Is the sum right?
levels.405.triggers.t405_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The power of cage combinations is fully unleashed—only a few empty cells remain!
levels.405.triggers.t405_c.text: 🎉 In-cage elimination perfected! You're starting to think like a true Killer Sudoku master!
levels.406.title: Lu Lu Tong Teahouse
levels.406.teachingGoal: Chapter Four comprehensive test: notes, Hidden Single, Twin Luminary, Three Seed Method, in-cage elimination, Star Balance Law—all techniques combined.
levels.406.triggers.t406_s.text: 📜 The final test of the dust-covered cold case! A crossroad—this level fuses every technique of the chapter: notes, Hidden Radiance, hidden pairs, Three Seed Method, in-cage elimination!
levels.406.triggers.t406_f1.text: Nice! Every correct fill is a step toward the truth!
levels.406.triggers.t406_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! Multiple techniques collide—you've found the most critical opening!
levels.406.triggers.t406_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Systematic sweep: fill all Lone Stars → scan Hidden Radiance → find pairs → check cage combinations → Three Seed Method, in that order!
levels.406.triggers.t406_st40.text: 💡 Make good use of notes and the combination calculator! The more carefully you mark early in an advanced board, the easier it gets later. Don't skip steps!
levels.406.triggers.t406_ag.text: ⚠️ A trap in the cold-case maze—one wrong number loses the whole board. Think twice!
levels.406.triggers.t406_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The Senior Detective Badge is within reach—hold on to the end!
levels.406.triggers.t406_c.text: 🎉 Congratulations on passing the dust-covered cold case! The Senior Detective Badge is unlocked! The secrets at the heart of the Library await you ahead!
levels.407.title: Another Path
levels.408.title: The Backup Radio
levels.409.title: Triple Alignment
levels.501.title: Preparing the Transmitter
levels.501.teachingGoal: Nested cage introduction: cages can contain other cages; subtract the inner cage's sum from the outer cage's sum to deduce the values of the middle-layer cells.
levels.501.triggers.t501_s.text: Welcome to the heart of the Library! Level 1: nested cages. Observe the board—some cages are entirely contained within another cage; that's the nested structure!
levels.501.triggers.t501_f1.text: Right! Subtract the inner cage's sum from the outer cage's sum to work out the middle-layer numbers! This is the basic reasoning of nested cages!
levels.501.triggers.t501_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've peeled away one layer of the nested cage—the chain reaction begins!
levels.501.triggers.t501_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Find cages nested one inside another—subtract the inner cage's sum from the outer cage's sum, and the difference is the sum of the cells unique to the outer cage!
levels.501.triggers.t501_st40.text: 💡 Nested cage technique: solve the innermost layer first, then work outward layer by layer. Like peeling an onion, each layer gives you new clues!
levels.501.triggers.t501_ag.text: ⚠️ Judge the nested structure carefully—confirm which cells belong to the outer cage but not the inner one. Count wrong and the whole board goes wrong!
levels.501.triggers.t501_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! Every layer of nesting is unraveled—the final numbers are right before you!
levels.501.triggers.t501_c.text: 🎉 Nested cage introduction complete! You're beginning to understand the complex structure of the archives!
levels.502.title: Blackout
levels.502.teachingGoal: Irregular cages: cages with irregular shapes that may cross multiple box boundaries, requiring flexible use of the Star Balance Law and combination analysis.
levels.502.triggers.t502_s.text: Level 2: irregular cages! This level's cages have irregular shapes, winding like snakes across multiple boxes—the key is to split them apart!
levels.502.triggers.t502_f1.text: Good! Irregular cages look complex, but once split into segments, each segment can be handled with Star Balance or combination analysis!
levels.502.triggers.t502_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've split the irregular cage into calculable segments—the key numbers emerge!
levels.502.triggers.t502_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Don't look at an irregular cage as a whole! Use the 3×3 box boundaries to cut it into segments, then compute differences with Star Balance for each segment!
levels.502.triggers.t502_st40.text: 💡 Long cage technique: cages with many cells may actually have few combinations—for example, a 5-cell cage summing to 15 can only be 1+2+3+4+5! Check combinations with the calculator!
levels.502.triggers.t502_ag.text: ⚠️ Watch the cage boundaries! The dashed borders of irregular cages are easy to misread—confirm which cage a cell belongs to before filling!
levels.502.triggers.t502_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! Every segment of the irregular cage is conquered—the last steps are easy!
levels.502.triggers.t502_c.text: 🎉 Irregular cages tamed! No matter how strange the cage shape, it can't scare you anymore!
levels.503.title: The Direction-Finding Van
levels.503.teachingGoal: Compound cage combinations: multiple cages overlap, using their shared cells as bridges to set up and solve simultaneous equations.
levels.503.triggers.t503_s.text: Level 3: compound cage combinations! Multiple cages overlap, sharing some cells—write out their sum relationships and solve them like equations!
levels.503.triggers.t503_f1.text: Nice! You've spotted the sum relationship between two cages—the shared cells are the key bridge!
levels.503.triggers.t503_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've solved the compound cage's equations—the key numbers are confirmed!
levels.503.triggers.t503_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Find two cages with overlapping cells, add and subtract their sums—often you can cancel the shared cells and work out the independent parts!
levels.503.triggers.t503_st40.text: 💡 Compound cage math: cage A sums to X, cage B sums to Y, they share k cells (sum S). Then A's unique part + S = X, B's unique part + S = Y—subtract the two equations to cancel S!
levels.503.triggers.t503_ag.text: ⚠️ Are you clear on the shared cells? One wrong number during elimination and everything goes wrong!
levels.503.triggers.t503_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The compound is fully dismantled—every cage cell comes to light!
levels.503.triggers.t503_c.text: 🎉 Compound cage combinations mastered! You're starting to view the cage game with mathematical thinking!
levels.504.title: The First Message
levels.504.teachingGoal: Advanced Star Balance: consider sum relationships across multiple rows, columns, and boxes at once (e.g., the 90 rule for two rows/two boxes, the 135 rule for three rows).
levels.504.triggers.t504_s.text: Level 4: multi-box Star Balance! You've mastered single-row and single-column Star Balance; this level you look at multiple boxes at once—two boxes sum to 90, three boxes to 135!
levels.504.triggers.t504_f1.text: Right! Combine two boxes to see a sum of 90—the difference range is wider, revealing clues invisible to a single box!
levels.504.triggers.t504_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! The combined multi-box Star Balance shows its power—a seemingly impossible puzzle unravels!
levels.504.triggers.t504_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Try viewing two adjacent boxes or two rows as a single whole—the sum is 45×N! The difference method applies the same way!
levels.504.triggers.t504_st40.text: 💡 Multi-box mnemonic: 'Look big, not small.' If a single box yields no opening, widen your view to 2×2 boxes, three boxes, three rows!
levels.504.triggers.t504_ag.text: ⚠️ Multi-box calculations need care—90 or 135? Which boxes are combined? Who counts the boundary cells?
levels.504.triggers.t504_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! Star Balance expands from single boxes to the whole field—the final answer holds no suspense!
levels.504.triggers.t504_c.text: 🎉 Multi-box Star Balance mastered! Every level of the Star Balance Law is now within your grasp!
levels.505.title: The Second Message
levels.505.teachingGoal: Comprehensive cage game: combined use of nested cages, irregular cages, compound cages, and the multi-box Star Balance Law.
levels.505.triggers.t505_s.text: Level 5: comprehensive cage game! Nested, irregular, compound, multi-box—every cage type at the heart of the Library appears here!
levels.505.triggers.t505_f1.text: Good! Stay calm and bring every cage-type technique into play!
levels.505.triggers.t505_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! A breakthrough in one cage type triggers a chain of solutions across the others!
levels.505.triggers.t505_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Start with the innermost nested cage or the most obvious difference—don't attack the most complex compound cage directly!
levels.505.triggers.t505_st40.text: 💡 Comprehensive cage strategy: ① mark all notes ② compute all single-box differences ③ find nested cages ④ split irregular cages ⑤ solve compound cages ⑥ finish—step by step!
levels.505.triggers.t505_ag.text: ⚠️ On a high-difficulty board, one wrong step loses everything! Every step needs solid evidence!
levels.505.triggers.t505_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The core secrets of the archives are about to be fully revealed!
levels.505.triggers.t505_c.text: 🎉 Comprehensive cage game cracked! You now have what it takes to challenge the highest difficulty!
levels.506.title: The Third Message
levels.506.teachingGoal: Chapter Five comprehensive test: nested cages, irregular cages, compound cages, multi-box Star Balance Law, plus the ultimate test of every technique learned so far.
levels.506.extract.message: Coordinates decoded %s—cross-check with 8280 to determine the receiving station.
levels.506.triggers.t506_s.text: 📜 The Library's core trial! This is the core puzzle left by the teacher—the ultimate test of every cage technique!
levels.506.triggers.t506_f1.text: A brave first step! The turning of the archives begins here!
levels.506.triggers.t506_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! The core gears of the archives begin to turn—the puzzle crumbles layer by layer!
levels.506.triggers.t506_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Return to the basics—Star Balance, pairs, blocks, cage combinations—they're always the most reliable weapons!
levels.506.triggers.t506_st40.text: 💡 Take a deep breath and start again from another corner. Sometimes the hardest part of the board isn't the breakthrough—the simple spot is the entrance!
levels.506.triggers.t506_ag.text: ⚠️ The teacher set a trap at the core—this number looks correct but leads to a contradiction in the whole!
levels.506.triggers.t506_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The Elite Detective Badge is just ahead—don't slacken on the final step!
levels.506.triggers.t506_c.text: 🎉 Congratulations on conquering the Library's core! The Elite Detective Badge is unlocked! The final cage game—the teacher's last puzzle—awaits you!
levels.507.title: Evacuation Before Dawn
levels.508.title: Yamada's File
levels.509.title: Dawn
levels.601.title: The Accounting Room
levels.601.teachingGoal: Final cage game · One: deep nested cages combined with large cage sums—advanced reasoning over multi-layer nested structures.
levels.601.triggers.t601_s.text: 📜 'You've finally reached the finale. Every cage game here was laid by my own hand—don't expect an easy pass.' —Teacher
levels.601.triggers.t601_f1.text: The first cell is correct, but this is only the beginning. The teacher's puzzles are defended layer by layer!
levels.601.triggers.t601_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've found the first crack the teacher left behind—charge through it!
levels.601.triggers.t601_st20.text: 💡 The final cage game's difficulty soars, but the techniques stay the same—first compute every possible difference and unique combination, patiently building your advantage!
levels.601.triggers.t601_st40.text: 💡 The teacher's style: few clues early on, but once you break through, it's unstoppable. Keep marking notes—the opening will surely appear!
levels.601.triggers.t601_ag.text: ⚠️ The teacher's traps are everywhere—one guess could undo all your progress. Let reasoning speak!
levels.601.triggers.t601_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! You've breached the first line of the finale!
levels.601.triggers.t601_c.text: 🎉 The first level of the finale is broken! The teacher's puzzles are not invincible!
levels.602.title: The Bookstore
levels.602.teachingGoal: Final cage game · Two: large cage sum analysis—combination enumeration and cross-constraints for oversized cages (6+ cells).
levels.602.triggers.t602_s.text: 📜 'Large cage sums—when a cage is bigger than a box, can you still see the truth?'
levels.602.triggers.t602_f1.text: Good! Though large cages have many cells, their sum range is limited—fewer combinations than you'd think!
levels.602.triggers.t602_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've locked onto the large cage's unique combination—the board opens up instantly!
levels.602.triggers.t602_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Don't panic over large cages—use the combination calculator to enumerate all possible combinations, then eliminate one by one with row/column/box constraints!
levels.602.triggers.t602_st40.text: 💡 Large cage technique: if some numbers in the large cage are already confirmed, subtract them from the sum—the remaining sub-cage's combination range shrinks dramatically!
levels.602.triggers.t602_ag.text: ⚠️ One wrong number in a large cage makes every later combination wrong—verify thoroughly!
levels.602.triggers.t602_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The fog over the large cage clears—the answer is right before you!
levels.602.triggers.t602_c.text: 🎉 Large cage sums tamed! No matter how big the cage, it can't cage your reasoning!
levels.603.title: Bridge No. 4
levels.603.teachingGoal: Final cage game · Three: extreme reasoning—multi-step chained reasoning requiring Star Balance + combinations + pairs + blocks.
levels.603.triggers.t603_s.text: 📜 'Extreme reasoning—this level requires you to link every technique you've learned into one complete reasoning chain.'
levels.603.triggers.t603_f1.text: Good! The first link is connected—keep extending your reasoning chain!
levels.603.triggers.t603_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've clicked the most critical link of the reasoning chain—smooth sailing from here!
levels.603.triggers.t603_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? This level needs long-chain reasoning—after filling a number, immediately check what new possibilities it opens!
levels.603.triggers.t603_st40.text: 💡 Extreme reasoning strategy: every time you confirm a number, update all notes in its row/column/box/cage—new Lone Stars, Hidden Radiance, or pairs may appear at any moment!
levels.603.triggers.t603_ag.text: ⚠️ One error in long-chain reasoning collapses everything after it—if you spot a contradiction, immediately return to the nearest confirmed point!
levels.603.triggers.t603_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The long chain of extreme reasoning has reached its final link!
levels.603.triggers.t603_c.text: 🎉 Extreme reasoning succeeds! Your logical chain is now unbreakable!
levels.604.title: The Old Lu Lu Tong Site
levels.604.teachingGoal: Teacher's Puzzle · One: a high-difficulty cage game designed by the teacher himself, fusing multiple advanced techniques.
levels.604.triggers.t604_s.text: 📜 'The first puzzle. I spent three days and nights designing it—let's see how long you need.' —Teacher
levels.604.triggers.t604_f1.text: A decent start. But the teacher's puzzle won't let you see through it that easily!
levels.604.triggers.t604_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've torn through the teacher's first layer of disguise!
levels.604.triggers.t604_st20.text: 💡 The teacher's style: he likes to hide the most obvious clues beside the most complex cages—is there a simple Star Balance Law you overlooked?
levels.604.triggers.t604_st40.text: 💡 This puzzle needs multiple iterations: the first scan finds 3-5 numbers, the second scan finds 3-5 more based on the new numbers—iterate patiently!
levels.604.triggers.t604_ag.text: ⚠️ 'Are you sure? Think again.' —The teacher seems to be watching you. At every step, ask yourself: is this reasoning or guessing?
levels.604.triggers.t604_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The teacher's first puzzle is about to be cracked!
levels.604.triggers.t604_c.text: 🎉 Teacher's Puzzle · One solved! His puzzles are not unbreakable—keep going!
levels.605.title: The Transmitter
levels.605.teachingGoal: Teacher's Puzzle · Two: a harder teacher cage game, demanding extremely keen observation and multi-technique coordination.
levels.605.triggers.t605_s.text: 📜 'The second one. Harder than the first. If you give up here, I won't blame you—most people stop right here.' —Teacher
levels.605.triggers.t605_f1.text: Brave. But the depth of this puzzle far exceeds your imagination.
levels.605.triggers.t605_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've found an opening even the teacher thought was well hidden!
levels.605.triggers.t605_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? This puzzle's opening isn't inside the cages but in the relationships between cages—study the shared cells and overlapping regions closely!
levels.605.triggers.t605_st40.text: 💡 The key to the teacher's second puzzle: combined multi-box differences. If a single box yields no clue, try viewing two or even three boxes together!
levels.605.triggers.t605_ag.text: ⚠️ 'Close, but not enough.' —This error will trap you in a dead end in the final stage. Turn back while you can!
levels.605.triggers.t605_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The teacher's second puzzle is about to fall—the ultimate cage game awaits!
levels.605.triggers.t605_c.text: 🎉 Teacher's Puzzle · Two solved! You've surpassed most detectives—the ultimate cage game lies ahead!
levels.606.title: Traces
levels.606.teachingGoal: Final trial: the teacher's ultimate puzzle—a highest-difficulty challenge combining every technique.
levels.606.triggers.t606_s.text: 📜 'The ultimate cage game. The crystallization of everything I learned in my life. If you can solve it—you'll be worthy of knowing what really happened between Ito and me.' —Teacher
levels.606.triggers.t606_f1.text: The first move is made. This is your final game against the teacher!
levels.606.triggers.t606_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've struck the core of the ultimate cage game—the whole puzzle begins to collapse!
levels.606.triggers.t606_st20.text: 💡 The ultimate cage game contains everything—take a deep breath and start from zero: ① mark notes ② scan all Star Balance differences ③ find unique-combination cages ④ pairs/Three Seed Method ⑤ Block Severance ⑥ iterate!
levels.606.triggers.t606_st40.text: 💡 'When reasoning reaches a dead end, return to the original rules.' —The three iron laws (no repeats in rows/columns/boxes) are always the final weapon. Is there a note violating an iron law that you overlooked?
levels.606.triggers.t606_ag.text: ⚠️ No guessing is allowed in the ultimate trial! If you need to guess, it means you haven't found the right reasoning path—keep searching!
levels.606.triggers.t606_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The Master Detective Badge is right before you—the teacher's truth is about to be revealed!
levels.606.triggers.t606_c.text: 🎉 Congratulations on graduating! You have become a true Killer Sudoku master!
levels.607.title: Yamada's Raid
levels.608.title: Traces of Shen Shi'an
levels.609.title: Pan Hanyu
levels.701.title: The Western Suburb Warehouse
levels.701.teachingGoal: Learn Twin Lock (Naked Pair): when two cells in the same region can only hold the same two numbers, those two numbers can be eliminated from other cells in that region.
levels.701.triggers.t701_auto_0.text: Scroll One, 'The Lock of Pairs': observe the board and first fill all Lone Stars you can see at a glance (cells missing only one number in their row/column/box). Fill until you find you can't advance—that's when you need the Twin Lock.
levels.701.triggers.t701_auto_3.text: 💡 Try marking each empty cell's possible numbers with the notes (✏️ button). When two cells can only hold the same two numbers, a 'pair' forms—those two numbers can be eliminated from other cells in the same row/column/box.
levels.701.triggers.t701_c.text: 🎉 The Lock of Pairs is solved! The Twin Lock becomes the first arcane weapon in your repertoire. Next scroll: The Hidden Key.
levels.701.triggers.t701_ag.text: ⚠️ Errors in the arcane archives are especially fatal—are you sure this number was really eliminated by the pair?
levels.701.triggers.t701_st40.text: 💡 One more hint: the key to a pair is 'two cells, exactly two notes, in the same region.' First find all cells with only two notes, then check whether their notes are identical!
levels.701.triggers.t701_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've found the key pair—once the elimination takes effect, the board accelerates!
levels.701.triggers.t701_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The ripple of the pair elimination cleared the last obstacles!
levels.702.title: 72 Dsiswei Road
levels.702.teachingGoal: Learn Twin Luminary (Hidden Pair): when two numbers can only appear in the same two cells within a region, those two cells can only be those two numbers, eliminating other candidates.
levels.702.triggers.t702_auto_0.text: Hint: Twin Luminaries aren't easy to spot directly. Try checking numbers one by one—does a number appear in only two positions in this row/column/box? If another number also appears in exactly those two positions, that's a Twin Luminary!
levels.702.triggers.t702_auto_1.text: 💡 The key to a Twin Luminary: don't look at what candidates a cell has—look at where the numbers can go.
levels.702.triggers.t702_f1.text: Right! You've spotted the Twin Luminary—though the cells have multiple candidates, 2 and 7 can only go in these two cells!
levels.702.triggers.t702_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've caught the Twin Luminary—the redundant candidates are swept away!
levels.702.triggers.t702_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? For a Twin Luminary, 'look at numbers, not cells': pick two numbers, check their possible positions in a row/column/box—if they're exactly the same two cells, that's a Twin Luminary!
levels.702.triggers.t702_ag.text: ⚠️ For a Twin Luminary, confirm these two numbers really only go in these two cells—missing one position means wrongly deleting candidates!
levels.702.triggers.t702_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The Hidden Key opens the final door to the answer!
levels.702.triggers.t702_c.text: 🎉 Twin Luminary mastered! 'Naked looks at cells, hidden looks at numbers'—both forms of the pair are in your grasp!
levels.703.title: The Old Bookstore on Avenue Joffre
levels.703.teachingGoal: Learn Three Seed Method (Naked Triple): three cells in the same region contain exactly 3 different numbers, so those 3 numbers can be eliminated from other cells in that region.
levels.703.triggers.t703_auto_0.text: Hint: the hallmark of the Three Seed Method is three cells whose notes together contain exactly 3 different numbers. Common patterns: {a,b},{b,c},{a,c} or {a,b,c},{a,b},{a,c}, etc.
levels.703.triggers.t703_auto_1.text: 💡 When hunting for the Three Seed Method, focus on cells with few notes (2-3 candidates) and check whether their 'set' is exactly 3 numbers.
levels.703.triggers.t703_f1.text: Found it! Three cells contain exactly three numbers—the Three Seed Method is locked!
levels.703.triggers.t703_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! The Three Seed Method is locked—all three numbers are eliminated from the other cells in the region!
levels.703.triggers.t703_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Find three cells whose notes together are exactly three different numbers (e.g., various combinations of {3,5,8})!
levels.703.triggers.t703_ag.text: ⚠️ Judging the Three Seed Method: if three cells together have four or more different notes, it's not a Three Seed Method!
levels.703.triggers.t703_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The three-chain formation is broken—the final numbers surface naturally!
levels.703.triggers.t703_c.text: 🎉 Three Seed Method perfected! From pairs to three-chains, your pattern recognition has reached a new level!
levels.704.title: Suzhou Creek
levels.704.teachingGoal: Learn Twin Axis Formation (X-Wing): if a number can only appear in the same two columns across two rows, that number can be eliminated from other positions in those two columns.
levels.704.triggers.t704_auto_0.text: Hint: the Twin Axis Formation won't appear immediately—it takes shape only after candidates converge. First advance the board with the elimination techniques you know; when a number's positions in rows/columns start narrowing, the four corners of the rectangle will appear!
levels.704.triggers.t704_auto_1.text: 💡 Twin Axis Formation checklist: ① pick a number ② mark where it can go in each row ③ find two rows sharing the same two columns ④ eliminate that number from other positions in those two columns. You can also start from columns to find rows.
levels.704.triggers.t704_f1.text: Good, keep advancing! The board is still open—fill the confirmed numbers first and let the candidates converge—the Twin Axis Formation is taking shape.
levels.704.triggers.t704_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! The wings of the Twin Axis Formation spread—that number is eliminated from all other positions in the same columns!
levels.704.triggers.t704_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? How to find a Twin Axis Formation: pick a number, find two rows where it can only appear in the same two columns—those four cells form a rectangle!
levels.704.triggers.t704_ag.text: ⚠️ A Twin Axis Formation requires that in these two rows the number can only appear in these two columns (no third column)—otherwise it's not a Twin Axis Formation!
levels.704.triggers.t704_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The full power of the Twin Axis Formation is unleashed—the last few cells are in plain view!
levels.704.triggers.t704_c.text: 🎉 Twin Axis Formation mastered! You've officially entered the realm of pattern-based reasoning!
levels.704.triggers.t704_pre.text: 🔍 Observe closely! The candidates are converging—pick a number and mark where it can go in each row. If you find two rows that can only go to the same two columns, the Twin Axis Formation rectangle appears!
levels.705.title: Vladivostok
levels.705.teachingGoal: Learn Swordfish (Three-Talent Fish Formation): the three-row, three-column extension of the Twin Axis Formation—if a number can only appear in the same three columns across three rows, that number can be eliminated from other positions in those columns.
levels.705.triggers.t705_auto_0.text: Hint: the Three-Talent Fish Formation is the three-row version of the Twin Axis Formation. How to find it: pick a number → check each row's candidate positions → if three rows' candidates happen to lie within three columns → eliminate that number from other positions in those three columns.
levels.705.triggers.t705_auto_1.text: 💡 The Three-Talent Fish Formation is harder to find than the Twin Axis Formation. Use scratch paper to record candidate positions row by row, hunting for a three-row, three-column coverage pattern. Don't lose heart—this is one of the hardest techniques!
levels.705.triggers.t705_f1.text: Sharp eyes! The three-row, three-column outline of the Three-Talent Fish Formation is beginning to appear!
levels.705.triggers.t705_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! You've found the Three-Talent Fish Formation—that number is cleared from all other positions in the three columns!
levels.705.triggers.t705_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? The Three-Talent Fish Formation is the three-row version of the Twin Axis Formation: find a number that can only appear in the same three columns across three rows—nine cells form a web!
levels.705.triggers.t705_st40.text: 💡 The Three-Talent Fish Formation doesn't require every row to have three positions—each row just needs 2-3, all within the same three columns! Scan number by number patiently!
levels.705.triggers.t705_ag.text: ⚠️ The Three-Talent Fish Formation is complex—confirm that all possible positions of this number in these three rows really lie within these three columns; not a single one may spill into a fourth column!
levels.705.triggers.t705_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The Three-Talent Fish Formation dives into the sea—the final puzzle crumbles with it!
levels.705.triggers.t705_c.text: 🎉 Three-Talent Fish Formation conquered! You've mastered one of the most powerful advanced patterns!
levels.706.title: The Accounting Room
levels.706.teachingGoal: Use all advanced techniques together (pairs, Three Seed Method, Twin Axis Formation, Three-Talent Fish Formation) to crack the ultimate arcane cage game left by the teacher.
levels.706.triggers.t706_auto_0.text: The ultimate trial: this puzzle requires every advanced technique you've learned. Start with the simple ones (naked single → Hidden Radiance → pairs → Three Seed Method → Twin Axis Formation → Three-Talent Fish Formation) and advance step by step. Don't rush—observe carefully.
levels.706.triggers.t706_auto_1.text: 💡 When you hit a bottleneck, go back and check whether you missed a pair or a Three Seed Method. Advanced techniques often hide behind basic eliminations.
levels.706.triggers.t706_f1.text: The first step of the arcane ultimate challenge! Pairs, three-chains, Twin Axis Formation, Three-Talent Fish Formation—use them all!
levels.706.triggers.t706_bt.text: ⚡ Breakthrough! The five arcane techniques work in concert—the ultimate puzzle begins to collapse!
levels.706.triggers.t706_st20.text: 💡 Stuck? Sweep in systematic order: Lone Star → Hidden Radiance → Twin Lock → Twin Luminary → Three Seed Method → Twin Axis Formation → Three-Talent Fish Formation, advancing layer by layer!
levels.706.triggers.t706_st40.text: 💡 A hint from the arcane master: the easiest thing to miss early on an advanced board is the Hidden Radiance (Hidden Single)! Before hunting patterns, make sure all Hidden Radiance is filled!
levels.706.triggers.t706_ag.text: ⚠️ The arcane ultimate trial tolerates no guessing! Every pattern must be strictly verified—otherwise a miss by a hair is a miss by a mile!
levels.706.triggers.t706_fit.text: ✨ Finishing! The Arcane Master Badge is about to be crowned—the final truth is right before you!
levels.706.triggers.t706_c.text: 🎉 Congratulations, you are now an Arcane Master! All five advanced techniques—Twin Lock, Twin Luminary, Three Seed Method, Twin Axis Formation, Three-Talent Fish Formation—are fully mastered!
